result.topic_en: Calculations of log k and log k' (elliptic modulus) from q-series at rational points q = e^{xi}, x = mπ/(2n), expressing the values through finite sums over residues involving roots of unity α = e^{πi/(2n)}, with small numerical tables of residues for checking.

methods.what: q-series for log k' and its rewriting as a cosecant series at q = e^{xi}
Evaluation of -log k' at rational x = mπ/(2n) as a finite sum with integer-part function ε
Splitting series by residues mod 4n and representing via integrals of x^{s-1}/(1-x^{4n})
Partial fraction expansion in roots of unity α = e^{πi/(2n)} giving logarithmic sums
Numerical tables of residues of mσ for checking the sums
